picks.title: Caine Prize initiates ‘human-centred process’ after Zimbabwean winner accused of AI use
picks.excerpt: The Caine Prize for African Writing has released a statement following accusations made in the Atlantic that winner Simbarashe Kundizeza may have used AI.
picks.rationale: A major literary prize formally changes its judging process after an AI-use accusation against its winner. This is a concrete institutional response, separate from the earlier Orélien/Goncourt case.

picks.title: David Revoy bans AI derivatives of Pepper&Carrot and all his work
picks.excerpt: The open-source comic artist added an 'AI derivation prohibited' clause to the Creative Commons licenses covering his art, lore, stories and comics, citing a flood of daily permission requests from st
picks.rationale: A well-known open-licence comics creator adds an explicit no-AI-derivatives clause to CC-licensed work. Other creators can copy this licensing move directly.

picks.title: AI Prompt Found in a Printed Book: 'The Road to the End' Mistook Proofreading Instructions for the Main Text, All Copies
picks.excerpt: Recently, a reader posted about an absurd scene in the physical book 'The Road to the End': a sentence that reads, 'Please help me fine-tune some sentences so t
picks.rationale: An AI editing prompt was printed in every copy of a published book. It is a vivid production-QA failure that tells editors exactly what to check before print.

picks.title: [스타트업-ing] 하이브마인드, K-웹소설 해외 문턱 낮춘다① AI가 허무는 번역비 장벽
picks.excerpt: 한국 콘텐츠 산업이 외형적으로 급성장하며 해외 진출을 늘리고 있지만, 웹소설은 영상 콘텐츠에 비해 여전히 높은 진입 장벽에 가로막혀 있다. 과도한 번역비는 물론, 출판과 유통(퍼블리싱) 과정에 대한 지원 체계가 미비해 시간과 비용 부담이 크기 때문이다.먼저 해외 진출…
picks.rationale: A named Korean startup uses AI translation to cut the cost of taking K-webnovels overseas. It is a concrete business model for AI-driven export of serialized fiction.

picks.title: Yuriten Exhibit Cancels 10th Anniversary Event After Artists Criticize Its AI Use
picks.excerpt: Organizers: Contractor used AI-generated imagery for planned Tokyo event
picks.rationale: A manga/yuri art exhibition cancelled its anniversary event after artists objected to AI imagery from a contractor. It shows what AI use by vendors can cost when artists push back.

alternates.title: 유명 연예인이나 성우 목소리로 들었는데···듣는 소설, 오디오북도 이제 ‘AI 성우’ 시대?
alternates.excerpt: 집필, 번역, 표지 제작 등 출판의 다양한 분야에 인공지능(AI) 기술이 사용되고 있는 가운데 오디오북 시장에도 AI의 사용이 확대되고 있다. 교보문고 온라인 사이트에서 ‘오디오북’을 검색하고 인기순으로 정렬하면 첫 페이지에서 AI가 사용된 오디오북을 쉽게 찾을 수 있다. 종이책에 저자와 번역자 정보를 표시하는 것처럼 오디오북도 낭독자 정보를 공개한다...
alternates.rationale: Korean audiobook market check: AI narrators already fill Kyobo's top audiobook listings, which raises the question of narrator disclosure.
